doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Branford introduces his wife Nicole to the camera
summary: He interrupts to introduce his wife Nicole, who had just received her Masters degree.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: He didn’t…. Hey Nicole. C’mon in. Come over here please. See ya’ll need to meet my wife. She’s really pretty and she’s smart too. She’s smart and she’s pretty. It’s better that way. She just got her Masters degree just two weeks ago. So she’s the only person in the house that has actual degrees. So clearly she’s the smartest one. Nicole: He says this with tongue firmly planted in his cheek.
No I’m not. That’s some bullshit. I’m serious. Anthony, Ken…. (introduces Nicole) Nicole: Nice to meet you.
Come here please. Say “hi” to the virtual peoples. Nicole: Hello virtual peoples. I’m the smart one. (laughter)
If we’re lucky, you know, a hundred years from now somebody’ll see it. And they’ll say, “Who are those people?” Nicole: Exactly. Especially her.
